name: University of California, Berkeley
summary: Public research university in Berkeley, California: 130+ academic departments in six colleges and one school; you apply to a college and major.

ib.text: No IB points minimum. Berkeley reads your record holistically and counts IB courses and results; IB English A at HL 5 or SL 6 shows English proficiency, otherwise TOEFL 90 or IELTS 6.5.

dates.label: UC application closes (one round for everyone)

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences
programmes.about: First-years are admitted directly into the EECS major and stay four years, with a hands-on, interdisciplinary curriculum in electrical engineering and computer science.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to EECS directly on the UC application; holistic review of grades, essays and activities. Taking extra maths and science helps.

flagshipSource.title: Berkeley EECS: the BS, admitted directly into the major

programmes.name: Spieker Undergraduate Business Program (Haas)
programmes.about: The Berkeley Haas four-year BS in Business Administration. High school seniors apply on the UC application, then submit a Haas supplement with an essay and a video interview upload.
programmes.selectionNote: Haas judges grades and coursework, essays, and activities and awards; the supplement follows the UC application. Check the Haas page for the current supplement date.

flagshipSource.title: Berkeley Haas: the Spieker Undergraduate Business Program

faculties.name: College of Letters and Science
faculties.line: Broad liberal arts, sciences and social sciences majors; a first-year choice of major within a high-demand policy.

faculties.name: College of Engineering
faculties.line: Apply directly to an engineering major; extra maths and science courses are encouraged.

faculties.name: College of Computing, Data Science, and Society
faculties.line: Berkeley's newest college: Computer Science, Data Science and Statistics majors.

faculties.name: Haas School of Business
faculties.line: UC application plus a Haas supplement with essay and video interview; grades and coursework, essays, activities.

notes: Berkeley offers no early admission or early decision; every applicant uses the same filing period, October 1 to November 30.
For 2026-27, UC tuition and fees are $18,214 and new out-of-state students pay a further $39,270 in nonresident supplemental tuition.
International students on a visa cannot be classed as California residents for tuition and must show funds for the first year before a visa document is issued.
